received_works.body:
Dear YUIGA, My name is Katusha. I was attracted by your beautiful illustration, and I would like to make a request.
Here are the details of my request.

I would like you to draw a flower of OC, a space siya.

The image of the character is a bunny, so we would like you to draw her as a rabbit.
We are sorry to trouble you with the composition, etc., but we will leave it to you.

We would appreciate it if you could check the character design from Google Drive at the document URL.

Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gyolgA0kj3BwzHpRtPuWI9HLBwBKgU8b

こんにちは、Yuigaさん！👋
はじめまして。お元気でしょうか？😄

Skebでイラストレーターさんを探しているときにYuigaさんを知りました。ぜひイラストをお願いしたいと思い、ご連絡しました！
とても可愛くてユニークな作風や、キャラクターをとても愛らしく、そしてキラキラと輝くように描かれるところが本当に大好きです。あなたのスタイルはまさに唯一無二です！🥰🥰🥰

描いていただきたいのは、私のふわふわのドラゴンの男の子です！
彼は元気で、カリスマ性があり、冒険好きでとても幸せな性格です。

具体的なアイデアは特にありませんが、毛色に合った可愛い鈴付きの首輪をつけている姿をお願いできればと思います。それ以外はすべてあなたに決めていただきたいです☺️

Yuigaさんはとても才能のある方なので、きっと素晴らしい作品に仕上げてくださると信じています！😆

このリクエストをご検討いただければ幸いです。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
素敵な一日をお過ごしください！！❤️💜

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/175SL7H91hYIrIsWqU6FdTguZo3Bag6aQ

ゆいがさん、こんにちは！
早速ですが、近々ゆるめの創作グループを作りたいと思っておりまして、
そこで使うロゴの文字デザインを是非お願いしたいのです。可能でしょうか、、

■名前
・Alchemist

■文字のデザインに沿えてほしいもの
・フラスコ
・黒猫
（⇒ゆいがさんの腕を信頼しています、、ので、指示にあまりとらわれず...！自分の下手な指示でゆいがさんのセンスが上手く発揮されないことを恐れているのです。デザイン上無いほうが上手くいきそうでしたらおきがるに無視してくださいませ、、！）

もしお時間ありましたらよろしくです！

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ErMWiRg2U0sjXxlodaaQMLfsbeEM1OAb/view?usp=sharing

Hello! I would love to get my Fennec Fox-Shark Hybrid drawn by you!

I'm looking to use it mainly as a profile picture, so bust up would work perfectly for me, preferably in a cute pose with his ski mask on his forehead or off entirely. I do not have a preference when it comes to their torso clothing being on or off.

And if its not too much to ask, an aquatic themed background would be amazing!

His reference is linked below as well:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1k8rr4zViS544Y-WMF-Z85Dm_j2HVyosP?usp=sharing

I apologise if the reference isn't enough or up to standard, this is my first time making a request to get something drawn so I am not entirely sure what to expect! Nonetheless, thank you for taking the time to read!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1k8rr4zViS544Y-WMF-Z85Dm_j2HVyosP?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you!
I'm attracted by your delicate style, and I'd like to make a request.
I would like to ask you to draw my child "Haruka Tokimiya" together with my friend's characters "Sturm" and "Furia".
I will leave the details such as clothing to ʏᴜɪɢᴀ, but I would be happy if you could draw them in a warm atmosphere as if they are all smiling and getting along with each other even in the cold winter with snow flying around!
I would also like to use your work as a wallpaper for my PC, so may I ask for a resolution of 1920×1080?
If you feel that it is inconvenient for you, such as not being worth the price, you may refuse the request.
Below we share the materials of the three people on GoogleDrive.
We would be happy to accept your request!
Thank you very much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18ulLY2KknV_Oo15XfsBbwb41gpYGVxbk?usp=drive_link

Hello! You can draw freely, thank you!~

https://drive.google.com/file/d/15hTW4bWzmH99i9BVrqPDxFC3GsINLCAy/view?usp=sharing

Hi! 

I wanted to request a drawing of my character in your style.
The pose and action is your decision, but keep in mind he is bashful and lazy.

You can share the artwork on SNS.

I will attach a reference sheet for my character.

Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/7u7eCZe

Hello, I'm a new member of the board and I'm looking forward to meeting you! Nice to meet you!
I would like you to draw my Ori-character, Theo-kun!
He is a kitsuneko boy (almost a fox).
I would be happy if you could put on some ornaments.
Red collar and black ear cuff (right)
I would be happy if you could draw him as he is cute and friendly 🦊.
Posing and other details are up to you!
Please do!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PTdr-bCNoCXYmZgW_KZP-j0KCcgaLiLv

Hello, I would like to have my character drawn by you! https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Lb-3PbbOyS08xq04xLJKuDF41MJcp2jF?usp=sharing

He has a small bite mark in the left ear.

He can be drawn in any pose or expression you see fit!

He doesn't have to wear any clothing, but If you want you can give him a dark beige cargo short.

Hello!

I love your artstyle, do you think you could draw my blueberry fox?
I'm going to use it as profile picture so bust up is good enough.

You can use your creative freedom as you wish.
He likes being silly and the only accessory he has is a collar.

I currently don't have many drawn references but I hope photos are okay.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Cwkd_TiSq2PlzoimyHm9jP4Q1LjCoD3B

Thank you so much in advance!

Hi, you make such beautiful art! I would love it if you could draw my character, Monica?
She's a dog person who loves puzzles and ice cream!

She can be drawn however, no need to stick closely to the reference sheet. She can also wear different clothing if you want.

Thank you so much for considering my request, have a great day!

https://toyhou.se/2286789.monica#80489466

Nice to meet you. I would like to apply because your drawing is very beautiful. This character is curious and has doodles on his feet. I would like to see this character as a ticklish figure or sitting in a daze. As long as the pose shows the whole body, the rest of the background accessories, etc. can be done with ease. The character would be happy to refer to the material in the google drive link.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ehg9mYgfunTfqmeHsfVlIXPtCxdt8kfi?usp=drive_link

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KpWdyM_v5UguNetzIyyDFFrnqbRw1OmA/view?usp=sharing
you can draw him however you like
(i originally forgot the link like a fool, sorry)

Hey there!

I was wondering if I could get something of my bard bat practicing some lighting elemental magic while wearing his leather armor. Maybe channeling his magic through a Lute Instrument?

The link should have both the main ref and the armor ref!
https://imgur.com/a/Jtel4Dj

https://imgur.com/a/Jtel4Dj

Hello, I want to have my new character drawn in your style. I will be using it as a profile picture and banner for social media, and as an art reference.

Please use the face, ears, and headband from the design on the right. Please use the clothes, body, and tail from the design on the left. Any pose is fine as long as he looks adventurous and happy, and his full body is visible.

If the payment amount I have submitted is not enough, please feel free to increase the amount.

Thank you very much and I look forward to working with you!

Image link: https://ibb.co/MZmwzGh

Hello! I love your art style is really cute. Could I get a drawing of this character. I’m not bothered about pose or outfit. But the expression is serious for them. Thank you!  https://imgur.com/a/lNa5nce

Hello! Thank you for all your wonderful illustrations!

I would like to request you to make an illustration of my cat as a beast.
She is a female Abyssinian named "Sakura" and she is a mixture of calmness and naughtiness.
Please leave the composition and the clothes to me!

Thank you very much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-8heBoo1M31TO27nhmNDEBd0RLcdu-oJ

Hello! 

I'd love to have my bunny drawn in your artstyle.

He can be drawn with his black robes on, having stronger bunny features with brown fur and a little black nose.

I'd like if he was drawn staring into his crystal ball.

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/djkp5wef7hrcdq0/AAAU9s-W9LGTPGRtzZ8eQOtGa?dl=0

I would like to request my goat character for my mobile phone background. You can use whatever pose, clothings, and background you see necessary.

https://us.ib.metapix.net/files/full/4258/4258222_Lanxide_stream_2.png

Hi!  I like your style so much!  I would like to commission you to paint me in your style.

https://imglf5.lf127.net/img/e9ad00c0a7b120b8/enQ5dVo4U29uYWExcndHTVNnai9seTJrMjhwRVA3YWpITWxDd1BLOTdIMD0.png?imageView&thumbnail=750x0&&quality=96&stripmeta=0%7Cwatermark&type=2&fontsize=340&dx=16&dy=20&font=bXN5aA%3D%3D&gravity=southwest&text=QOaUueWQjeWbsOmavum7jiBMT0ZURVIgSUTvvJo4ODU0MTQ2MjY4

My name is Shametaro and I'd like to make a request!
I'm so excited to be able to commission Yuga, who I love so much for her patterns and coloring...! I'm so happy to be able to commission you... 🥲💓

I would like you to draw Shakuma for me!
Please use Yuga's favorite hairstyle.
In the picture she is wearing nothing, but I would like her to wear a sailor uniform with a necktie. (I would be happy if the tie is not a ribbon type tie but a suit or something like that...!)
Also, I like glasses, so I want her to wear glasses.
Please leave the pose and expression to me.
Thank you very much!

https://mobile.twitter.com/same_taro_san/status/1551217523806285825?s=21&t=725ODzLGtOt6wLWiN1LHVg
I would like to see a taur with 20 legs playing! No specific creature or design, as long as it's furry.

I'd like you to draw my son Fukakun...
I don't specify the composition, but I'd like a face with a hint of darkness.
Please keep it a secret that I'm alive 🤫🙏(I'd be happy if you don't tweet me)
Also, please make the ears bigger than the material because it's an old material.

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FFMs8kUacAMXL9b?format=jpg&name=4096x4096
